options.label: model
options.description: Goose resolves the model from its own config. atrium cannot enumerate per-provider models (launcher_options is static JSON and cannot cascade off the provider field), so switch models in-session with /model.

options.label: provider
options.description: Optional. Overrides goose's configured provider for this session (e.g. openrouter, anthropic). Leave blank to inherit goose's config.

options.label: effort
options.description: Goose's own default is off, and the supported levels depend on the active model. Leave blank to inherit; change in-session with /model or set GOOSE_THINKING_EFFORT.
